digest.overview: AI startups are attracting major venture capital investment in 2026. Recent deals show significant funding rounds for enterprise-focused AI companies, with valuations climbing into the tens of billions as investors bet on agentic AI and AI-to-business solutions gaining traction.

items.headline: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B at $12B valuation
items.summary: Thrive Holdings, backed by OpenAI, secured $2 billion in new funding from prominent investors including SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital. The company is focused on bringing AI solutions to the enterprise market at scale.
items.why_it_matters: This mega-round signals continued confidence from tier-one VCs in AI enterprise applications, particularly those with OpenAI backing.

items.headline: Lovable reaches $13.3B valuation and raises another $400M
items.summary: Lovable, an AI startup, confirmed a new $13.3 billion valuation and closed an additional $400 million funding round. The company had previously achieved $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June, demonstrating rapid growth.
items.why_it_matters: Lovable's acceleration to a $13B+ valuation reflects investor enthusiasm for AI tools with proven revenue traction and strong product-market fit.

items.headline: Enterprise AI adoption challenges focus on data and infrastructure
items.summary: While AI agents are rapidly being adopted across organizations, many executives recognize that capturing genuine ROI from AI depends on establishing the right data foundation and infrastructure. Inadequate systems remain a barrier to realizing AI's potential in business.
items.why_it_matters: This highlights an emerging opportunity for AI infrastructure and data management startups that can help enterprises scale AI safely and effectively.
